source: Alex Hormozi — How I Gained 7.8M Followers in 40 Months

proof_promise_plan.name: Proof-Promise-Plan
proof_promise_plan.when: When writing video introductions or opening any educational content
elements: Proof: Why should they listen to you? Lead with results, credentials, or data
Promise: Tell them exactly what they will get from this specific piece
Plan: Set expectations for what happens next
proof_promise_plan.note: Order changes based on which element is strongest for that piece

content_buckets.name: Three Content Buckets
content_buckets.when: When deciding what type of content to create
content_buckets.insight: Entertainment and education audiences do not cross over in meaningful numbers. Pick one.

five_shifts_for_you.name: For Us to For You (5 Shifts)
five_shifts_for_you.when: When reviewing drafts or planning content structure
shifts: Packaging: Vague to Clear thumbnail and headline
Intros: Confirming the headline to Proof-Promise-Plan
Meat: Razzle-dazzle production to Steps plus Stories
Visuals: Overproduction to Effective production (charts, data)
Pre-work: Fix in post to Research before recording

rpm_paired_metric.name: RPM as Paired Metric
rpm_paired_metric.formula: RPM = Views x Revenue per View
rpm_paired_metric.why: Captures both quantity and quality. Higher RPM means you are reaching the right people. A 100K-view video can outperform a 10M-view video.

stranger_first.name: Assume Nothing (Stranger-First)
stranger_first.when: When writing content for any growing audience
rules: Explain why they should listen every time
No inside jokes or unexplained references
Warm people like reminders. Cold people need introductions

content_strategy_loop.name: Content Strategy Loop
content_strategy_loop.when: When planning your overall content strategy
loop: Start doing something (anything is better than nothing)
See what works better than the rest
Do as much of that as possible
content_strategy_loop.core_question: With the resources I have, how can I maximize the number of the right people who find out about my stuff?

key_tactics: Clear packaging beats curiosity gap for educational content
Language and message matter more than production effects (75% stat)
Narrow topics to attract your specific audience only
Long-form drives more business conversions than short-form
Ad revenue is a real-time leading performance indicator
Repost greatest hits to a growing audience
An ounce of pre-work is worth a pound of post-production
